verdict.rationale: Xero exposes a documented REST API, OpenAPI spec, and official SDKs (xero-node), plus 'Custom Connections' explicitly built for machine-to-machine (headless) integrations to a single org—directly supporting unattended/CI-style automation. However there's no explicit CLI, no CI-specific docs/examples, and no llms.txt (404), so headless usage requires custom scripting rather than an out-of-the-box CI tool. Missing for 10: dedicated CLI or CI/automation guide, explicit CI pipeline examples, independent confirmation of headless CI usage.
